source.probe: hb-shape widths of 207 Bengali paragraphs of a corpus document: Shonar Bangla over GenOffice Bengali 0.687 regular (p10-p90 0.674-0.706), 0.686 bold (0.673-0.700); hmtx of its Latin letters, digits, punctuation, quotes and space over Liberation Serif 0.827 for every glyph in both cuts; Word paces the face at its hhea box (10.5 pt at line 340 auto -> 19.7 pt)

note:
Shonar Bangla is an M365 cloud face Word downloads and renders real; macOS and
Chromium never see it, so Bengali runs fell to Kohinoor Bangla, 1.34x the Word
line width, and a 38-page Bengali document wrapped to 40 pages. Its glyphs sit
small in the em: the Bengali block is 0.69 of Nirmala UI's advances at a
near-constant ratio (one size-adjusted GenOffice Bengali face per weight) and
its Latin is Times at 0.827 for every glyph (the rangeless Liberation Serif
faces, which also keep quotes and dashes off the CJK tail). Every face pins the
cloud font's hhea box (0.8081 / 0.4863 regular, 0.8403 / 0.4775 bold) divided
by its size-adjust. Word has no italic cut; both sides synthesize it.
